en.headline: Centre reports imported chikungunya and dengue cases
en.dek: A 73-year-old man who had been on the mainland has recovered from chikungunya, and a separate dengue case was linked to travel in Vietnam.
body: The Centre for Health Protection reported on Friday one imported chikungunya infection and one imported dengue infection.

The chikungunya patient was a 73-year-old man who had been on the mainland during the incubation period. The centre said it considered the infection to have been acquired while he was travelling. He was treated in hospital in a mosquito-free setting and has been discharged after recovering. One household contact completed medical surveillance and did not develop symptoms.
The dengue patient had been in Vietnam during the incubation period, the centre said. It did not release further details of that case on Friday evening.
Both infections were classified as imported. The centre has not reported a new local mosquito-borne cluster in connection with the two cases.

zh.headline: 衛生防護中心公布輸入基孔肯雅熱及登革熱個案
zh.dek: 一名曾往內地的73歲男子感染基孔肯雅熱後已康復出院，另一宗登革熱個案的病人潛伏期內曾到越南。
body: 衛生防護中心周五公布，本港新增一宗外地傳入的基孔肯雅熱個案，以及一宗外地傳入的登革熱個案。
基孔肯雅熱患者是一名73歲男子，潛伏期內曾到內地。中心認為他是在外遊期間受感染，屬輸入個案。他已在無蚊環境下入院接受治療，其後康復出院。一名家居接觸者已完成醫學監察，沒有出現病徵。
登革熱個案的病人則在潛伏期內到過越南。中心周五傍晚未有公布該個案的進一步詳情。
兩宗均列為外地傳入。中心暫未公布與這兩宗個案相關的新本地群組。
